stories.title: 小明帮助别人
stories.description: 小明放学回家时，帮助一位驼背的老爷爷把沉重的袋子搬上楼，心里甜滋滋的。
stories.author: Tashini
stories.coverAlt: 放学铃响了，小明和同学们背着书包，轻快地走出校门口。

stories.title: The Morning Rush
stories.description: A sleepy boy oversleeps, misses his bus to school, and learns a lesson about going to bed early.
stories.author: Tashini
stories.coverAlt: Malfoy is fast asleep while his alarm clock rings and rings, dreaming that he is flying on a broomstick.
